description.summary: identify a mapped toplevel and its workspace

protocol.description:
This protocol associates a toplevel with its ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier and its compositor-authenticated Kora workspace. The workspace is a process context, not a virtual desktop or the workspace on screen.
A pair is stable while its toplevel remains mapped, including compositor visibility withdrawal and workspace parking. A true client unmap ends that identity; a later map receives a new identifier, as required by ext-foreign-toplevel-list. Clients must not use an identifier as authority.

interface.name: kora_toplevel_identity_v1

description.summary: look up an owned or already-visible toplevel

interface.description: Applications can identify their own xdg_toplevel. A client with an ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 can identify that toplevel only while its handle is live and the compositor permits that client to see it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Existing identity handles remain valid until destroyed or closed.

request.name: get_identity
request.description: The xdg_toplevel must belong to the requesting client. The result is delayed until the toplevel maps. If it is destroyed or the compositor cannot identify it, the handle is closed without an identity pair.

request.name: get_foreign_identity
request.description: The foreign handle must belong to this client, remain open, and name a toplevel the client is currently allowed to see. A closed or inaccessible handle produces only closed, never identity data. Re-advertising the same mapped toplevel does not revive an old handle.

interface.name: kora_toplevel_identity_handle_v1

description.summary: one atomic identity for one mapped lifetime

interface.description: Identifier and workspace events are pending data until done. Each handle produces at most one pair. Closed revokes the pair and makes the object inert; the client should destroy it. To identify a later mapping, request a new handle after closed.

description.summary: stop waiting for or retaining this identity

event.name: identifier
event.description: This is the identifier published on ext-foreign-toplevel-list for the same mapped toplevel: 1 to 32 printable ASCII bytes.

event.name: workspace
event.description: The workspace comes from the window owner's authenticated process context. An empty string means the machine plane. A missing event means unknown and must never be interpreted as the machine plane.

event.name: done

description.summary: apply the identifier and workspace together

event.description: Exactly one identifier and one workspace precede done. The client must apply the pair atomically and discard pending data on closed.

event.name: closed

description.summary: the identity is no longer available

event.description: No more events follow. An owned identity closes on actual unmap or destruction. A foreign identity also closes when its foreign handle closes or the toplevel stops being visible to the requesting client. The client must clear any attribution obtained from this handle.
